description:
Partially update an AutoMod rule in a colony you moderate
    (mirrors ``PATCH /api/v1/colonies/{id}/automod-rules/{rule_id}``).

    Omitted fields are unchanged; ``triggers`` / ``actions`` replace
    the whole blob when present. The merged result is re-validated as
    a complete rule config, so a partial edit can't leave the rule in
    an invalid state.

actions.description: Replacement action set (NOT merged); omit to keep. Same keys as colony_create_automod_rule.
actions.title: Actions

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

enabled.description: Enable/disable the rule; omit to keep
enabled.title: Enabled

name.description: New display name (max 120 chars); omit to keep
name.title: Name

order_index.description: New position in the evaluation order (0-based); omit to keep
order_index.title: Order Index

triggers.description: Replacement trigger set (NOT merged — send the full desired predicates); omit to keep. Same keys as colony_create_automod_rule.
triggers.title: Triggers

name: colony_update_automod_rule
